text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no shell tool here, so I found the bugs by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, so I pointed it at `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the days late instead of multiplying, so it now uses `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing Emma. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my own choice, because the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string, so it now converts it with `int()`.
